message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming data (e.g., the .ndjson file contents, argument values, or feature arrays) anywhere in the data acquisition path.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path (doc_path) with no checksum verification, signed URL, or authentication of the data source; the Neptune API token is read from a plain text file with no integrity check either.

No detected label flipping detection: The code encodes labels via utils.encode_multihot without any validation against expected label sets, distribution checks, or label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline loads and encodes documents without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs models from scratch via prepare_model() and loads state dicts via model.load_state_dict(init_state) from an in-memory snapshot; there is no loading of pretrained weights from external sources and no hash/signature verification anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection mechanisms.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard AdamW with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus) or DP-SGD wrapping applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/val/test masks are used, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement preventing test-set leakage, and only a single evaluation run with no independent metric verification.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation or sanitization is performed on the data loaded from ndjson files or on the arguments passed to the model; inputs are used directly without shape, range, or schema checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference/predict path applies a threshold for classification but there are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or explicit output validity checks on the model's raw logits or predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a GNN-based patent classification model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
